Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (4)
I should be able to do it.
She said the words, but she had no certainty. Yet, Valeria could not stand still.

The comrades to whom she had given her heart for the first time in her life were dying in vain every second, and the Genesis Knights, along with the person she loved, were shouldering the greatest pain on the front lines.
As the Coalition's only recording magician, as the 677th dimension's only Hister, she had to find something she could do.
Zipple, history manipulation, distortion.
The only ones who could be called their natural enemies were the Histers.
She had not yet reached perfection as she hadn't found all the heritage sites, while her enemy, on the other hand, had not only reached perfection but transcended it.
Nevertheless, it felt like there was something she could do.
There had to be something she could do.
If not, there was no reason for being born a Hister. No reason for enduring such overwhelming despair, loneliness, and responsibility as a Hister.
"Keuhh... For my brothers, my comrades, the world. I do not regret this life, Valeria."
Thud! Belize collapsed as she lowered Valeria from her back.
"Belize...!"
Tears streamed down Valeria's eyes as she hugged Belize's neck. With her last remaining strength, Belize raised a hand and wiped away her tears.
"So don't cry, not with your eyes, nor with your heart. And live, protect those who remain..."

Belize's hand, now cold, fell away. From a thousand paces before she had even reached the Genesis Knights' battlefield, a spear from Kelliark had already been embedded in the center of her Light-Heart.
Van, and Jin.

They did not cry out Belize's name in agitation. Postpone, postpone, postpone; it was a battlefield where one could not preserve their life for even a moment without dealing with sorrow in such a way. The moment it had even the slightest effect on the battle, Belize's death would be in vain.
Instead, Van covered Jin, and in that time, Jin positioned himself next to Valeria.

There wasn't even the leisure to call each other's names. From that moment, Jin protected Valeria and tried to close the distance to Luna, while Kelliark, as if annoyed by her, poured magic in their direction.
"Valeria Hister... Yes, I had forgotten about you. Huhu, it seems there is such a thing as emotion in this world. Seeing you cry like that, this too is refreshing."
"Van and I will block all the spears and beams, go to Luna!"
Countless spears raining down, Light Origin and Dark Origin magic, pillars of death that erased existence.
This time, Jin ran with Valeria on his back. Jin felt Valeria's tears on the back of his neck. But by the time they reached Luna, she was no longer crying.
Because she had to fight.
She had already examined the records while being carried. Valeria got off Jin's back and checked Luna's wound.
Can I fix it?
Can I return the reality forcibly twisted by Kelliark back to its place? Can I stop Luna from being erased from this world?
Soon, Valeria nodded her head.
"Miss Luna, I can solve this. Please focus only on the battle again. However, if you are hit too deeply by the Dark Origin magic, I cannot reverse that."
"That's enough."
Luna met Valeria's eyes once more, then shrouded Krantel in crimson energy again.
As Valeria closed her eyes and began to emit the unique blue magic of recording magic, she could truly feel the progression of the wound slowing down.
"You protect me, Jin."
"Of course."
"And I'm sorry. Your shoulder... I can't fix it."
Only Holy King Lani could heal Jin's shoulder. And even then, there wasn't much time left.
"It's just one arm. I'm fine, so focus. I will protect you, no matter what."
Jin wrapped Bradamante in shadow energy.
'Kelliark Zipple. Seeing that bastard again, it's laughable that I was ever conscious of whether I could remain human.'
He had to protect people.
He had to protect the person he loved, his comrades, and those who believed in and followed him. From the beginning, obtaining Solderet's final legacy was not a matter of choice.
But he could protect them even without it.

'I did not regress to obtain a life where I can't protect anything without such power. I will prove it to you, Kelliark Zipple. No matter how many worlds you have conquered, the one where I exist is only here.'
For what reason did I turn back time?
It was for moments just like this.
To protect this world, where the people I love exist.
For the first time since his regression.

Jin realized that the worry he had harbored for the longest time had finally ended. The people whose lives had changed due to his regression, those whose life and death had differed, those who had suffered, those who had been blessed.
All of them would have eventually been devoured and disappeared by that monster.
Nothing would have been left. Not a single person, not a single beast, not even a blade of grass. Therefore, to leave anything at all in this world, Jin had regressed.
The price for that was sorrow.
A sorrow that would never be again.
Despite focusing all his mind and senses on defending against Kelliark's attacks, Jin could hear the voices of his comrades dying behind him and the Genesis Knights.
They were being carried to him, as unavoidable as the blowing wind.
-Vanessa, rest easy.
-Lord Jed!
-Retreat, leave me behind!
-Black Kings, listen! Even if you die, send at least one more comrade to Laprarosa!
-Lord Owl...? Hi...? You're not dead, are you?
-Oh, Yona. You can make that face too. For me, that is... enough.
He must move forward on the wind. Even if the final voices of his loved ones, of those who had devoted their lives to the world, grew more distant.
If he endured and reached the legacy, this might be the last time. The last time he would face the unavoidable sorrow of being human and writhe in anguish.
Therefore, even if it was a promise he couldn't keep, he had to make it. He had to say he would protect her, even if he couldn't. Jin stood before Valeria like that.
"Kuh!"
With his already broken body, the powers of light and dark flew at him. Gritting his teeth, Jin's whole body trembled.
Kelliark was strong.
He blocked the vision of Chiron and Van, and while continuously enduring attacks containing the full power of the Genesis Knights, he persistently aimed for Valeria.
"Keoheok!"
When he blocked the Light Origin magic, his mind went blank. When he blocked the Dark Origin magic, a part of his body was erased.

Then, Valeria would seize the manipulated record with her blue magic and reshape Jin's body. If a shoulder disappeared, she would find a shoulder; if an arm disappeared, an arm; if a leg disappeared, a leg; if a heart disappeared, a heart.
The more she did, the more Kelliark, with an indifferent face, unleashed his authority with greater strength.
'Jin Runcandel is certainly special. But seeing him in person, he's not as shocking as Chiron Runcandel. Without them, it wouldn't be strange for him to fall at any moment... Wait, what is that?'
Kelliark's eyes widened. Because a golden energy, so perfect that even he was momentarily mistaken, was soaring up from all over the battlefield.
Golden energies shining like stars.
Even though the rain of Light and Dark Origin was chaotically and densely filling the battlefield, the sight of the golden energy spreading within it was visible.
Moreover, that energy was expanding rapidly. Not even Chiron's or Van's sword could push through Kelliark's magic at such a speed, at least not as far as Kelliark knew.
'...The Authority of Regeneration.'
The identity of the golden energy blooming like a flower was the Authority of Regeneration that Jin had obtained upon reaching the rank of Genesis Knight.
It wasn't the first time he had seen it. During his conquest of all dimensions, Jin was not the first enemy he had faced who used the Authority of Regeneration.
But there had never been an Authority of Regeneration so perfect and vast. Soon, Kelliark grinned as if he had discovered an unexpected jewel.
"I must take that power, Jin Runcandel. The reasons I must kill you have just increased by one."
Shiiik-!
A white spear that fell from the sky grazed Jin's right cheek. At that moment, Valeria flinched and couldn't help but lose her focus for a moment.
'Aging...!'
Kelliark had changed the direction of his attack.
Mindlessly trampling was not efficient with Chiron and Van around, and the method of erasing existence through manipulation and distortion was also being slowly blocked by Valeria's ability.
Kelliark still had many cards left. The next one he drew was 'time'.
"Even I have not yet fully obtained time. Can you handle even this? Valeria Hister of the 677th dimension."
Starting with the right cheek grazed by the white spear, Jin's face began to age rapidly.
Wrinkles formed and his skin sagged. Then, his muscles, which had been harder than steel even in the heat of battle, shriveled, and Jin instantly became an old man.
'I alone cannot handle the aging that is spreading to Jin and our comrades. I need Miss Quicantel's help!'
Since Luet was reading the battlefield, she was already sending Quikantel towards the Genesis Knights. However, Kelliark had already anticipated that and had prepared two countermeasures.
Of course, the authority and power that Quicantel possessed were by no means a threat to Kelliark.
But since even an ordinary piece of firewood can have meaning when thrown into a great fire, there was no reason not to cut it down if it could be done easily.
The first was to make the rain fall harder so that Quicantel could not pass, and the second was to make her despair even if she managed to break through the rain with someone's help.
"Come forth, Olta. Your creation dares to try and work a miracle. A silver dragon that has never shone in any world."
Zzzzzzzk-!
As Kelliark waved his hand, another dimensional gate opened before him. The next moment, what emerged from within was the being who had created Quicantel.
The God of Time, an Olta from another dimension. As soon as she felt that authority, Quicantel stopped flapping her wings and looked up at Olta.

Even though it was from another dimension, she couldn't say it was a different god. At least to Quicantel's perception, it was a completely identical being. Even though it had fallen to a state where it could no longer be called a god, having been subjugated by Kelliark.
[What shall I do, Lord Kelliark.]
To the bowed Olta's voice, Kelliark replied.
"Reclaim the life of your creation, and find your contractor and tear her to shreds."
